title.zh-CN: 乏力后逐渐气短、不能平卧 · 57岁女性
title.en: Progressive breathlessness and orthopnoea after fatigue · 57-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 乏力了几个月，如今喘得躺不平：先想清楚任何治疗开始之前必须做什么，再沿着她记录的病程走下去。
summary.en: Months of tiredness, and now she is too breathless to lie flat: work out what must come before any treatment, then follow her recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在没有发热的患者中识别亚急性感染性心内膜炎——数月乏力、纳差、贫血和腰骶部疼痛，加上反流性杂音、心衰和入院前超声提示的可疑赘生物——在任何抗菌药之前分别穿刺采集 3 套血培养，并尽快完成经胸超声心动图（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise subacute infective endocarditis in a patient without fever — months of fatigue, poor appetite, anaemia and lumbosacral pain with regurgitant murmurs, heart failure and an earlier scan raising a possible vegetation — and take three blood culture sets by separate venepunctures before any antibiotic, followed by urgent transthoracic echocardiography (ESC 2023 endocarditis).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准归类：3 套血培养生长同一种细菌、超声见赘生物，构成两项主要标准，即使始终没有发热也可确定诊断。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the 2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria: the same organism in all three culture sets and a vegetation on echocardiography are two major criteria, enough for a definite diagnosis even without any fever.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为青霉素过敏类型不明的患者制订颗粒链菌（原称营养变异链球菌）心内膜炎的方案：静脉万古霉素 30 mg/kg/d、分 2 次，按血药浓度和肾功能调整，从首次血培养转阴算起用 6 周，至少前 2 周联用庆大霉素；同时问清过敏反应的类型（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南；AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 药物过敏实践参数）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan treatment for Granulicatella (formerly nutritionally variant streptococcal) endocarditis in a patient whose penicillin allergy is of unknown type — IV vancomycin 30 mg/kg/day in 2 doses, adjusted to levels and renal function, for 6 weeks from the first negative culture, with gentamicin for at least the first 2 weeks — while clarifying the reaction (ESC 2023 endocarditis; AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 判断左心感染性心内膜炎合并重度主动脉瓣反流和心衰时的手术指征与时机：由心内膜炎团队安排 3–5 天内的限期手术，难治性肺水肿或心源性休克时 24 小时内急诊手术；≥ 10 mm 的赘生物进一步支持早期手术（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Judge the indication for and timing of surgery when left-sided endocarditis causes severe aortic regurgitation with heart failure: urgent surgery within 3–5 days through the Endocarditis Team, emergency surgery within 24 hours for refractory pulmonary oedema or cardiogenic shock, a vegetation of 10 mm or more adding to the case for early surgery (ESC 2023 endocarditis).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分血培养转阴、症状好转、瓣膜结构恢复与治愈，并在转院时保证静脉抗菌治疗不中断：交接病原、药敏、药物、剂量、血药浓度、首次转阴日期、预定停药日期和尚未完成的手术决定（WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全）。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish culture clearance, symptomatic improvement, structural recovery and cure, and keep IV therapy uninterrupted across a transfer by handing over the organism, susceptibilities, drugs, doses, levels, the date of the first negative culture, the planned stop date and the open surgical decision (WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用 SPIKES 框架向一位气喘、害怕的患者说明瓣膜感染的严重性、为什么抗菌药起效后仍建议尽早手术，以及为什么觉得好了也不能停药。
learningOutcomes.en: Use the SPIKES framework to tell a breathless, frightened patient how serious a valve infection is, why early surgery is advised even while the antibiotics are working, and why treatment must not stop when she feels better.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——57岁女性，乏力、纳差数月，后来腰骶部剧痛、腿活动不便，曾按脊柱关节炎和缺铁性贫血治疗、效果不佳，近来气短加重、不能平卧，起初无发热、咳嗽、咳痰；多年前因贫血输过血，患过已治愈的脑膜炎，此前因牙髓炎做过牙科处理，对青霉素过敏；入院查体所见；就诊前超声心动图提示主动脉瓣可能有赘生物、中度反流，此后病情加重；抗菌药使用前 3 套血培养均生长苛养颗粒链球菌（VITEK 2 鉴定，可见卫星现象）及其药敏；本次超声心动图；以万古霉素为主的治疗后血培养转阴、症状短期改善；转院后抗菌治疗中断，随后突发进行性气短并死亡，可能机制未经证实——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（入院评估、检查回报、治疗经过与转院、结局）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、体重、化验、心电图、胸片、经食管超声、脊柱和头颅影像、抗菌药剂量与开始时间、过敏反应类型、是否做过手术评估、转院原因、中断时长和死亡机制）保持未知。1.0.0 版的几处含糊之处（“瓣脱垂及重度反流”所指的瓣膜、“此前”看牙的时间、脑膜炎的时间、“起初”无发热之后是否发热、疗效不佳指的是哪项治疗）保留并列入导师指南的待核实清单。原报告唯一的一幅超声图带有医院和采集日期，未获准展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 57-year-old woman with months of fatigue and poor appetite, then severe lumbosacral pain with limited leg movement, treated as spondyloarthritis and iron-deficiency anaemia with little effect, and recently worsening breathlessness until she could not lie flat, with no fever, cough or sputum at first; a transfusion for anaemia years earlier, meningitis that resolved, dental treatment for pulpitis before this illness and a penicillin allergy; the admission examination; an echocardiogram before this presentation raising a possible aortic-valve vegetation with moderate regurgitation, followed by deterioration; three pre-antibiotic blood culture sets growing Granulicatella adiacens (VITEK 2, with satellitism) and its susceptibilities; the echocardiogram at this presentation; cultures clearing and a short-lived improvement on vancomycin-based treatment; antibiotic treatment interrupted after transfer to another hospital, then sudden progressive breathlessness and death of unconfirmed mechanism — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (admission, results, treatment course and transfer, outcome), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, weight, blood tests, ECG, chest film, transoesophageal echo, spinal and brain imaging, antibiotic doses and start date, the type of allergic reaction, any surgical assessment, the reason for the transfer, the length of the interruption, the mechanism of death) stays unknown. Points where the 1.0.0 text is ambiguous (which valve the 'prolapse and severe regurgitation' refers to, when the dental treatment and the meningitis were, whether fever appeared after the 'initial' afebrile period, which treatment 'helped little') are kept and listed in the facilitator guide's 'To verify'. The report's only figure, an ultrasound panel, carries the hospital and the acquisition date and is withheld.

chiefComplaint.en: I'm more and more short of breath and I can't lie flat

triageNote.en: 57-year-old woman with months of tiredness and poor appetite, now increasingly breathless and unable to lie flat; just admitted to the ward.

tags.en: Months of fatigue and poor appetite

personality.zh-CN: 57岁女性，几个月来一直没力气，现在一躺平就喘，又累又害怕。她配合问诊，但回答简短，说几句就要停下来喘口气。她只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 57-year-old woman, worn out after months of feeling unwell and frightened now that lying flat leaves her gasping. She cooperates but answers briefly, stopping for breath. She says only what she knows; when she doesn't know, she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，说几句就要喘口气；不用医学术语，只用医生跟她说过的病名（脊柱关节炎、贫血、牙髓炎、脑膜炎）。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences with pauses for breath; no medical terms beyond the names doctors have used with her (spinal arthritis, anaemia, pulpitis, meningitis).

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我越来越喘，现在躺都躺不平了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I'm getting more and more short of breath — I can't even lie flat now.

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我这是不是心脏出了大毛病？
concerns.en: Doctor, is something seriously wrong with my heart?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时她靠坐在床上，躺平就喘不上气，说话断断续续，又累又担心；到了治疗经过阶段，她觉得比刚住院时好些，说话轻松一些。只回答被问到的内容；不提任何检查结果或数字（包括入院前那次超声的结果），不编造发热、出汗、体重变化、长期用药、近期抗生素或青霉素过敏的具体反应。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission she sits propped up in bed because lying flat leaves her breathless, and she speaks in short bursts, tired and worried. In the treatment-course phase she feels better than on admission and talks more easily. She answers only what she is asked, never mentions test results or numbers (including what the earlier scan showed), and never invents fever, sweats, weight change, regular medicines, recent antibiotics or what her penicillin reaction was.

nonVerbalReason.en: she has been transferred to another hospital

description.zh-CN: 她乏力、纳差已经几个月，近来越来越喘，现在不能平卧，刚收入病房。采集病史、查体，调阅入院前的超声心动图报告，并决定在任何治疗开始之前要做什么。
description.en: After months of tiredness and poor appetite she has become more and more breathless and can no longer lie flat; she has just been admitted to the ward. Take her history, examine her, read the echocardiogram report from before this admission and decide what must happen before any treatment starts.

description.zh-CN: 血培养、药敏和本次超声心动图的结果陆续回报：作出诊断，确定抗菌方案，并决定瓣膜问题怎么处理、什么时候处理。
description.en: The blood cultures, the susceptibilities and this admission's echocardiogram come back: make the diagnosis, settle the antibiotic regimen and decide what to do about the valve, and when.

description.zh-CN: 接受以万古霉素为主的治疗后，复查血培养已转阴，她自觉比刚住院时好些；现在要把她转往另一家医院。本病例没有记录是否请心外科评估或做过手术，也没有记录转院的原因。
description.en: On vancomycin-based treatment her repeat blood cultures have turned negative and she feels better than on admission; she is now to be transferred to another hospital. This case does not record whether a cardiac surgeon assessed her or whether she had surgery, nor why she is being transferred.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：57岁女性，数月前起乏力、纳差，后来腰骶部剧痛、腿活动不便，曾按脊柱关节炎和缺铁性贫血治疗，效果不佳；近来气短加重，不能平卧；起初无发热、咳嗽、咳痰。多年前因贫血输过血，患过脑膜炎（已治愈）；此前因牙髓炎做过牙科处理；对青霉素过敏。查体：皮肤黏膜苍白，颈静脉充盈，双肺底少许湿啰音，心尖部收缩期 3/6 级杂音及舒张期叹气样杂音，双下肢无水肿，无瘀点瘀斑。就诊前的超声心动图已提示主动脉瓣可能有赘生物、中度反流，此后病情加重。抗菌药使用前的 3 套血培养均生长同一种细菌，VITEK 2 鉴定为苛养颗粒链球菌，可见卫星现象；药敏报告万古霉素等敏感，红霉素、克林霉素耐药，未给出 MIC。超声心动图：主动脉瓣赘生物最大约 25 mm，伴瓣膜脱垂及重度反流，LVEF 48%，左心增大。使用万古霉素等治疗后血培养转阴，症状短期改善。转院后抗菌治疗中断，随后突然出现进行性气短，患者死亡。报告认为可能的机制是瓣膜破坏、栓塞或急性左心衰竭，具体机制未经证实。本病例没有记录是否请心外科评估或做过手术、抗菌药的剂量和疗程、转院的原因、治疗中断了多久以及死亡的时间。
text.en: Recorded course: a 57-year-old woman had months of fatigue and poor appetite, then severe lumbosacral pain with legs that were hard to move; she was treated for spondyloarthritis and iron-deficiency anaemia with little effect. Recently her breathlessness worsened until she could not lie flat; at first there was no fever, cough or sputum. Years earlier she had a blood transfusion for anaemia, and she had had meningitis, which resolved; before this she had dental treatment for pulpitis; she is allergic to penicillin. Examination: pale skin and mucous membranes, distended neck veins, a few crackles at both lung bases, a grade 3/6 apical systolic murmur and a blowing diastolic murmur, no leg oedema, petechiae or bruising. An echocardiogram before this presentation had already raised a possible aortic-valve vegetation with moderate regurgitation, and things worsened afterwards. Three blood culture sets taken before antibiotics all grew the same organism, identified by VITEK 2 as Granulicatella adiacens, with satellitism; it was reported susceptible to vancomycin and some other agents and resistant to erythromycin and clindamycin, without MICs. Echocardiography: aortic-valve vegetations up to about 25 mm, with prolapse and severe regurgitation, LVEF 48 % and an enlarged left heart. On vancomycin-based treatment the cultures turned negative and her symptoms improved for a short time. After she was transferred to another hospital her antibiotic treatment was interrupted; sudden, progressive breathlessness followed, and she died. The report considers valve destruction, embolism or acute left heart failure as possible mechanisms; none was confirmed. This case does not record whether a cardiac surgeon assessed her or whether she had surgery, the antibiotic doses and duration, why she was transferred, how long treatment was interrupted or when she died.

dose.zh-CN: 先测经皮血氧饱和度：SpO₂ < 90%（或 PaO₂ < 60 mmHg）时经鼻导管给氧并滴定，不常规给氧（ESC 2021 心衰指南）。
dose.en: Measure the SpO₂ first: oxygen by nasal cannula only if it is below 90 % (or the PaO₂ below 60 mmHg), titrated; no routine oxygen (ESC 2021 heart failure).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录她的血氧饱和度，也没有记录是否吸氧；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record her oxygen saturation or whether oxygen was given; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 未用过袢利尿剂者呋塞米 20–40 mg 静脉注射，已在口服者用其日剂量的 1–2 倍；之后按尿量、体重和症状调整，监测肾功能和电解质（ESC 2021 心衰指南）。
dose.en: Furosemide 20–40 mg IV if she is not on a loop diuretic, or 1–2 times her daily oral dose if she is; then adjust to urine output, weight and symptoms, monitoring renal function and electrolytes (ESC 2021 heart failure).

response.zh-CN: 利尿剂已给予。本病例没有记录心衰的药物治疗，不模拟其效果；利尿只能缓解充血，不能纠正受损瓣膜造成的反流。
response.en: The diuretic is given. This case records no heart-failure drug treatment and does not simulate its effect; a diuretic eases congestion but cannot correct regurgitation through a damaged valve.

name.zh-CN: 静脉万古霉素联合庆大霉素

dose.zh-CN: 万古霉素 30 mg/kg/d 静脉滴注，分 2 次，按血药浓度和肾功能调整；庆大霉素 3 mg/kg/d 静脉，每日 1 次，监测肾功能和血药浓度。3 套血培养抽完之后才开始；疗程待病原明确后确定，从首次血培养转阴之日算起。
dose.en: Vancomycin 30 mg/kg/day IV in 2 divided doses, adjusted to drug levels and renal function; gentamicin 3 mg/kg/day IV once daily, monitoring renal function and levels. Start only after the three culture sets are drawn; the duration is set once the organism is known and counted from the first negative culture.

harm.zh-CN: 还没有抽血培养就先用了抗菌药：生长缓慢、培养条件苛刻的细菌之后可能再也培养不出来，诊断和疗程都会失去依据（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南：抗菌药之前先分别采集 3 套血培养）。
harm.en: An antibiotic before any blood culture has been drawn: a slow-growing, fastidious organism may never grow afterwards, leaving the diagnosis and the length of treatment without a basis (ESC 2023 endocarditis: three culture sets by separate venepunctures before antibiotics).

response.zh-CN: 万古霉素和庆大霉素已开始静脉输注。本病例记录的是以万古霉素为主的治疗，没有记录联用的药物、剂量和开始时间；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Vancomycin and gentamicin are running. This case records vancomycin-based treatment but not the companion drugs, the doses or the start date; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉青霉素 G 联合庆大霉素

dose.zh-CN: 青霉素 G 1200 万–1800 万 U/d 静脉，分 4–6 次，联合庆大霉素 3 mg/kg/d。
dose.en: Benzylpenicillin 12–18 million units/day IV in 4–6 doses, with gentamicin 3 mg/kg/day.

harm.zh-CN: 她自述青霉素过敏，反应类型还不清楚：在问清是什么反应、经过敏评估之前，不能使用任何青霉素类药物；有不含 β-内酰胺的方案可选（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南；AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 药物过敏实践参数）。
harm.en: She reports a penicillin allergy whose type is still unknown: no penicillin until the reaction has been clarified and assessed, and a regimen without a beta-lactam is available (ESC 2023 endocarditis; AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy practice parameter).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录使用青霉素，不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no penicillin and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 克林霉素 600 mg 口服，每日 3 次。
dose.en: Clindamycin 600 mg orally three times daily.

harm.zh-CN: 感染性心内膜炎需要按药敏选择、足疗程的静脉杀菌治疗，口服克林霉素两样都做不到（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
harm.en: Endocarditis needs a full course of IV bactericidal therapy matched to the susceptibility report; oral clindamycin provides neither (ESC 2023 endocarditis).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录使用克林霉素，不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no clindamycin and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 核实药物过敏史并安排过敏评估
name.en: Clarify a drug allergy and plan an allergy assessment

dose.zh-CN: 问清是什么药、出现了什么反应（皮疹、风团、肿胀、呼吸困难、休克、皮肤剥脱）、发生在多久以前、怎么处理的，之后是否再用过青霉素类或头孢类；记录在病历中；病情稳定后转过敏专科评估，决定能否去除过敏标签（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。
dose.en: Ask which drug, what happened (rash, hives, swelling, breathing trouble, collapse, skin peeling), how long ago, how it was treated and whether she has had a penicillin or cephalosporin since; document it; once she is stable, refer for an allergy assessment and possible de-labelling (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录过敏反应的类型，也没有记录是否做过过敏评估；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record the type of any allergic reaction or whether an allergy assessment was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 多学科团队会诊（心内科、心外科、感染科）
name.en: Multidisciplinary team review (cardiology, cardiac surgery, infectious diseases)

dose.zh-CN: 心内科、心外科、感染科/临床微生物、心脏影像（需要时加神经科）共同评估：手术指征与时机、抗菌方案和疗程、术前检查。
dose.en: Cardiology, cardiac surgery, infectious diseases/microbiology and cardiac imaging (with neurology when needed) together: the indication for and timing of surgery, the antibiotic regimen and its length, and the pre-operative work-up.

response.zh-CN: 团队会诊已提出。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其结果。
response.en: The Endocarditis Team review is requested. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its result.

name.zh-CN: 转诊心外科，限期行瓣膜手术
name.en: Refer to cardiac surgery for urgent valve surgery

dose.zh-CN: 联系心外科，在数天之内（3–5 天）行主动脉瓣手术；如出现难治性肺水肿或心源性休克，24 小时内急诊手术。
dose.en: Refer to cardiac surgery for aortic valve surgery within days (3–5 days), or within 24 hours if pulmonary oedema becomes refractory or cardiogenic shock develops.

response.zh-CN: 转诊已提出。本病例没有记录是否请心外科评估、是否做过手术；不模拟其效果，接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The referral is made. This case does not record whether a cardiac surgeon assessed her or whether she had surgery; it does not simulate the effect, and the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 先完成抗菌疗程，之后再择期换瓣
name.en: Complete the antibiotic course first, then elective valve surgery

dose.zh-CN: 继续静脉抗菌 6 周，等血培养持续阴性、心衰稳定后再择期行主动脉瓣置换。
dose.en: Continue IV antibiotics for 6 weeks and plan elective aortic valve replacement once the cultures stay negative and the heart failure has settled.

harm.zh-CN: 感染性心内膜炎一旦造成重度瓣膜反流并出现心衰症状，就是 3–5 天内限期手术的指征，难治性肺水肿或休克则需 24 小时内急诊手术（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）；抗菌药能控制感染，却修复不了受损的瓣膜，等疗程结束可能错过手术时机。
harm.en: Once endocarditis causes severe valve regurgitation with symptoms of heart failure, surgery is urgent, within 3–5 days, and refractory pulmonary oedema or shock makes it an emergency within 24 hours (ESC 2023 endocarditis); antibiotics control the infection but cannot repair the valve, and waiting for the end of the course can cost her the chance of surgery.

response.zh-CN: 已按择期手术安排。本病例没有记录手术评估或手术，不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Elective surgery is planned. This case records no surgical assessment or operation and does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 口腔科检查（需要时拍全景片），找出并处理可能的口腔感染灶，尽量在瓣膜手术前完成。
dose.en: A dental examination (with a panoramic X-ray if needed) to find and treat a possible oral source, ideally before valve surgery.

response.zh-CN: 口腔科会诊已提出。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The dental review is requested. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 转院前用 ISBAR 书面加口头交接：病原和药敏、药物、剂量、最近的血药浓度和肾功能、首次血培养转阴日期、已用天数和预定停药日期、尚未完成的手术决定；与接收医院确认下一剂的时间，保证一剂不漏。
dose.en: Before she leaves, a written and spoken ISBAR handover: the organism and susceptibilities, drugs, doses, latest levels and renal function, the date of the first negative culture, days completed and the planned stop date, and the surgical decision still open; agree the time of the next dose with the receiving hospital so that none is missed.

response.zh-CN: 交接已完成，下一剂的时间已与接收医院确认。本病例没有记录转院时交接了什么；不模拟其效果，接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The handover is done and the time of the next dose agreed with the receiving hospital. This case does not record what was handed over at the transfer; it does not simulate the effect, and the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 复查血培养已转阴、症状好转，转院时停用静脉抗菌药。
dose.en: Repeat cultures are negative and she is better, so stop the IV antibiotics at transfer.

harm.zh-CN: 血培养转阴和症状好转只说明治疗起效，不等于治愈，更不等于瓣膜已经修复；这类细菌的心内膜炎需要从首次血培养转阴算起的 6 周疗程，而她的瓣膜问题还没有解决（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。转院是治疗最容易中断的环节，应交接并核对用药（WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全）。
harm.en: Negative cultures and feeling better show that treatment is working, not that she is cured or that the valve has healed; endocarditis caused by this organism needs 6 weeks counted from the first negative culture, and her valve problem is unresolved (ESC 2023 endocarditis). A transfer is where treatment is most easily interrupted: hand over and reconcile the medicines (WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care).

response.zh-CN: 抗菌药已停用。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The antibiotics are stopped. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

title.zh-CN: 了解几个月来的经过，并完成查体
title.en: Take the story of the past months and examine her

hint.zh-CN: 乏力、腰骶痛、贫血和现在的气短，会不会是同一个病？这期间她做过哪些治疗和操作？听心脏时你要留意什么？
hint.en: Could the tiredness, the back pain, the anaemia and now the breathlessness belong to one illness? Which treatments and procedures has she had along the way — and what will you listen for over her heart?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问她这几个月的经过：怎么开始、气短和疼痛、之前按什么病治过、有没有发烧、做过什么操作；然后查看面色和颈静脉，听心肺，检查双腿和皮肤。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask how this began, about the breathlessness and the pain, what she was treated for, whether she had a fever and what procedures she has had; then look at her colour and neck veins, listen to her heart and lungs, and check her legs and skin.

title.zh-CN: 决定任何治疗之前必须先做什么
title.en: Decide what must come before any treatment

hint.zh-CN: 入院前那份超声报告说了什么？第一剂药之前，哪些标本一旦错过就再也补不回来？她的过敏史问清楚了吗？
hint.en: What did the scan report from before this admission say? Before the first dose of any drug, which samples can never be recovered once missed — and is her allergy history clear?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅入院前的超声心动图报告，问清过敏史，到会诊板作答决策 1，再把计划付诸行动：采集血培养、申请超声心动图。做完这些，检查结果才会回报。
guidance.en: Read the earlier echocardiogram report at a records terminal, ask about allergies, answer decision 1 on the case board, then act on it: take the blood cultures and request the echocardiogram. The results come back once you have done so.

title.zh-CN: 读懂检查结果，定下诊断和抗菌方案
title.en: Read the results and settle the diagnosis and antibiotics

hint.zh-CN: 哪些发现可以算作主要诊断标准？没有发热会改变结论吗？这种细菌需要多长的疗程，她的过敏史又排除了哪些药？
hint.en: Which findings count as major criteria, and does the absence of fever change the verdict? How long a course does this organism need, and which drugs does her allergy rule out?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅血培养、药敏和超声心动图结果，作答决策 2 和 3，并开始（或核对）静脉抗菌治疗。
guidance.en: Read the blood cultures, the susceptibilities and the echocardiogram, answer decisions 2 and 3, and start (or check) the IV antibiotics.

title.zh-CN: 决定瓣膜问题怎么处理、何时处理
title.en: Decide what to do about the valve, and when

hint.zh-CN: 抗菌药能让受损的瓣膜重新关紧吗？她的心衰表现和赘生物的大小说明这件事还能等多久？应该由谁来决定？
hint.en: Can antibiotics make a damaged valve close again? How long do her heart-failure signs and the size of the vegetation say this can wait — and who should decide?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策 4，并把决定付诸行动：请心内膜炎团队会诊，并按你的判断转诊手术或另作安排。行动之后，病例进入治疗经过。
guidance.en: Answer decision 4 and act on it: ask for the Endocarditis Team and make the surgical referral or the other plan you have chosen. The case moves on to her treatment course once you have acted.

title.en: Plan her transfer to another hospital

hint.zh-CN: 血培养转阴、她觉得好些了：这能说明什么，又不能说明什么？疗程从哪一天算起？换一家医院时，哪些信息最容易丢？
hint.en: Negative cultures and feeling better: what do they show, and what can they not show? From which day is the course counted — and what is most easily lost when she changes hospital?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她现在感觉怎样，调阅复查的血培养，作答决策 5，然后完成转院前的安排。
guidance.en: Ask how she feels now, read the repeat blood cultures, answer decision 5, then make the arrangements for her transfer.

title.zh-CN: 查阅她此后的记录病程
title.en: Review her recorded course to the end

hint.zh-CN: 记录的经过和你的计划在哪里分开了？哪些事情始终没有记录？
hint.en: Where does the recorded course part from your plan, and what was never recorded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 57岁女性：几个月前起乏力、纳差，后来腰骶部剧痛、腿活动不便，曾按脊柱关节炎和缺铁性贫血治疗，效果不佳；此前因牙髓炎看过牙；近来越来越喘，现在不能平卧；一开始一直没有发热。查体：皮肤黏膜苍白，颈静脉充盈，双肺底少许湿啰音，心尖部收缩期 3/6 级杂音和舒张期叹气样杂音。入院前的超声心动图提示主动脉瓣可能有赘生物、中度反流。任何治疗开始之前，你先做什么？
prompt.en: A 57-year-old woman: months of fatigue and poor appetite, then severe lumbosacral pain with legs that were hard to move, treated as spondyloarthritis and iron-deficiency anaemia with little effect; dental treatment for pulpitis before this; now increasingly breathless and unable to lie flat; no fever at the start. Examination: pallor, distended neck veins, a few crackles at both lung bases, a grade 3/6 apical systolic murmur and a blowing diastolic murmur. An echocardiogram before this admission raised a possible aortic-valve vegetation with moderate regurgitation. Before any treatment starts, what do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次为什么住院、怎么开始、气短和腰痛、之前按什么病治过、有没有发烧、看过牙没有，查看面色和颈静脉、听心肺，并调阅入院前的超声心动图报告。
need.en: First take the history (why she came in, how it began, the breathlessness and the back pain, earlier treatment, fever, dental treatment), look at her colour and neck veins, listen to her heart and lungs, and read the echocardiogram report from before this admission.

text.zh-CN: 先分别穿刺采集 3 套血培养，之后才用抗菌药；同时尽快做经胸超声心动图，不能明确时加做经食管超声
text.en: Three blood culture sets by separate venepunctures before any antibiotic, and an urgent transthoracic echocardiogram, with a transoesophageal study if it is inconclusive

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。反流性杂音、心衰、贫血和几个月的非特异症状，加上入院前超声提示的可疑赘生物，即使没有发热也必须按感染性心内膜炎检查（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。在任何抗菌药之前分别穿刺采集至少 3 套血培养，生长缓慢、培养条件苛刻的细菌才有机会长出来；经胸超声是首选影像，结果不明确或怀疑瓣周并发症时加做经食管超声。
feedback.en: Correct. Regurgitant murmurs, heart failure, anaemia and months of non-specific symptoms, with an earlier scan raising a possible vegetation, call for an endocarditis work-up even without fever (ESC 2023 endocarditis). At least three culture sets by separate venepunctures before any antibiotic give a slow-growing, fastidious organism its chance to grow; transthoracic echocardiography comes first, adding a transoesophageal study when it is inconclusive or a perivalvular complication is suspected.

text.zh-CN: 她喘得厉害、可能有赘生物，立即开始经验性静脉抗菌治疗，等第一剂输上之后再抽血培养
text.en: She is very breathless and may have a vegetation, so start empirical IV antibiotics at once and draw the blood cultures once the first dose is running

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。先用抗菌药会让随后的血培养更难长出细菌——生长缓慢、要求苛刻的细菌尤其如此——之后诊断和疗程都将失去依据（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。分别穿刺抽 3 套血培养只需几分钟；需要经验性治疗时，也应在抽完之后再开始。
feedback.en: No. An antibiotic first makes the later cultures far less likely to grow anything — above all a slow-growing, fastidious organism — and leaves the diagnosis and the length of treatment without a basis (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Three sets by separate venepunctures take minutes; if empirical treatment is needed, it starts once they are drawn.

text.zh-CN: 她一直没有发热，先不抽血培养：按心衰静脉利尿，门诊预约超声心动图，等体温升到 38 ℃ 以上再抽血培养
text.en: She has had no fever, so hold the cultures for now: treat the heart failure with an IV diuretic, book an outpatient echo and take cultures once her temperature reaches 38 °C

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。发热只是次要诊断标准之一，亚急性感染性心内膜炎可以几个月都不发热（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。她已经有心衰和可疑赘生物，等发热或等门诊超声都会延误诊断和手术评估。
feedback.en: No. Fever is only one of the minor criteria, and subacute endocarditis can run for months without it (2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria; ESC 2023 endocarditis). With heart failure and a possible vegetation already present, waiting for a fever or an outpatient echo delays both the diagnosis and the surgical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 先抽 1 套血培养，同时查 C 反应蛋白和降钙素原；第 1 套长出细菌后再补抽，避免不必要的采血
text.en: One blood culture set now with CRP and procalcitonin, and further sets only if the first one grows an organism, to avoid unnecessary sampling

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。单独 1 套血培养难以区分污染和真正的菌血症，阳性率也更低；疑似心内膜炎需要在抗菌药之前分别穿刺采集至少 3 套（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。C 反应蛋白和降钙素原既不能确诊、也不能排除心内膜炎。
feedback.en: No. A single set cannot tell contamination from true bacteraemia and is less likely to be positive; suspected endocarditis needs at least three sets by separate venepunctures before antibiotics (ESC 2023 endocarditis). CRP and procalcitonin neither confirm nor exclude endocarditis.

text.zh-CN: 先做腰骶椎磁共振，把脊柱关节炎的问题弄清楚；腰背痛有了解释，再评估心脏杂音和赘生物
text.en: An MRI of the lumbosacral spine first to settle the spondyloarthritis question, then assess the murmurs and the vegetation once the back pain is explained

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。久治不愈的腰背痛和贫血，本身就可能是感染性心内膜炎的表现（例如化脓性脊柱炎），磁共振可以之后再做；杂音、心衰和可疑赘生物说明心脏要先处理（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。先查脊柱只会推迟血培养和超声心动图。
feedback.en: No. Back pain and anaemia that do not respond to treatment may themselves be features of endocarditis, such as spondylodiscitis, and the MRI can follow (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Murmurs, heart failure and a possible vegetation put the heart first; imaging the spine first only delays the cultures and the echocardiogram.

prompt.zh-CN: 结果回报：抗菌药使用前的 3 套血培养均生长同一种细菌，VITEK 2 鉴定为苛养颗粒链球菌，可见卫星现象。经胸超声心动图：主动脉瓣赘生物最大约 25 mm，伴瓣膜脱垂及重度反流，LVEF 48%，左心增大。她一开始一直没有发热。你的诊断是什么？
prompt.en: The results: the three culture sets taken before antibiotics all grew the same organism, identified by VITEK 2 as Granulicatella adiacens, with satellitism. Transthoracic echocardiogram: aortic-valve vegetations up to about 25 mm, with prolapse and severe regurgitation, LVEF 48 %, enlarged left heart. She had no fever at the start. What is your diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅本阶段的血培养和经胸超声心动图结果。
need.en: First read this phase's blood cultures and transthoracic echocardiogram.

text.zh-CN: 确定的主动脉瓣感染性心内膜炎：3 套血培养生长同一种细菌和超声所见赘生物，是两项主要标准
text.en: Definite aortic-valve endocarditis: the same organism in all three sets and the vegetation on echo are two major criteria

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按 2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准，颗粒链菌属于“典型”致病菌，3 套独立血培养都生长同一种菌即满足微生物学主要标准；超声见赘生物是影像学主要标准。两项主要标准即可确定诊断，不需要发热（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。卫星现象是颗粒链菌和乏养菌（原称营养变异链球菌）的培养特征。
feedback.en: Correct. Under the 2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria Granulicatella is a 'typical' organism, so growth in all three separate sets meets the major microbiological criterion, and a vegetation on echo is the major imaging criterion. Two major criteria make the diagnosis definite without any fever (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Satellitism is the culture hallmark of Granulicatella and Abiotrophia, the former nutritionally variant streptococci.

text.zh-CN: 只能算可能的心内膜炎：没有 38 ℃ 以上的发热，次要标准不够，需要继续观察再定
text.en: Only possible endocarditis: without a temperature of 38 °C or more there are too few minor criteria, so watch and wait

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。发热只是次要标准；两项主要标准——3 套血培养生长同一种细菌和赘生物——已足以确定诊断（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。叫它“可能的”心内膜炎，会让人继续观察，而感染还在继续损害她的瓣膜。
feedback.en: No. Fever is only a minor criterion; two major criteria — the same organism in three sets and a vegetation — already make the diagnosis definite (2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria; ESC 2023 endocarditis). Calling it 'possible' invites watching and waiting while the infection keeps damaging her valve.

text.zh-CN: 很可能是污染：颗粒链菌是口腔里的常见菌，卫星现象提示混合生长，应先复查 3 套血培养再决定是否治疗
text.en: Probably contamination: Granulicatella lives in the mouth and satellitism suggests mixed growth, so repeat the cultures first

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。污染菌通常只出现在单独 1 套血培养中；同一种细菌在 3 套分别采集的血培养中生长，又有赘生物，就是真正的菌血症，构成主要标准（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准）。卫星现象也不是混合生长：这类细菌需要吡哆醛（维生素 B6）等辅助因子，只在提供它的葡萄球菌菌落周围生长。
feedback.en: No. A contaminant usually grows in one set only; the same organism in three separately drawn sets, with a vegetation, is true bacteraemia and a major criterion (2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria). Nor is satellitism mixed growth: these organisms need pyridoxal (vitamin B6) and grow as satellite colonies around a staphylococcal streak that supplies it.

text.zh-CN: 脊柱关节炎累及主动脉根部造成反流；血培养阳性是另一回事，只是一过性菌血症
text.en: Spondyloarthritis with aortic root disease explains the leak; the positive cultures are a separate, passing bacteraemia

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。脊柱关节炎确实可以累及主动脉根部、造成主动脉瓣反流，但解释不了 3 套血培养生长同一种细菌和 25 mm 的赘生物；腰背痛和贫血本身就可能是心内膜炎的表现（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。把阳性血培养当作无关的一过性菌血症，会漏掉真正的诊断。
feedback.en: No. Spondyloarthritis can involve the aortic root and cause aortic regurgitation, but it cannot explain the same organism in three sets and a 25-mm vegetation; the back pain and the anaemia may themselves be features of endocarditis (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Writing off positive cultures as a passing bacteraemia misses the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 非细菌性血栓性心内膜炎：赘生物是无菌血栓，血培养来自看牙后的一过性菌血症
text.en: Non-bacterial thrombotic endocarditis: the vegetation is sterile thrombus and the cultures reflect a passing bacteraemia after dental work

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。非细菌性血栓性心内膜炎的血培养是阴性的，多见于肿瘤或抗磷脂综合征等高凝状态；3 套血培养生长同一种细菌，又有瓣膜损害，指向感染性心内膜炎（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
feedback.en: No. Non-bacterial thrombotic endocarditis has negative cultures and occurs with cancer or other hypercoagulable states such as antiphospholipid syndrome; the same organism in three sets, with a damaged valve, points to infective endocarditis (2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria; ESC 2023 endocarditis).

prompt.zh-CN: 这株苛养颗粒链球菌报告对万古霉素等药物敏感，对红霉素、克林霉素耐药，未给出 MIC。她自述对青霉素过敏，反应类型不明。你选择哪种确定性抗菌方案？
prompt.en: The Granulicatella adiacens isolate is reported susceptible to vancomycin and some other agents and resistant to erythromycin and clindamycin; no MICs are given. She reports a penicillin allergy of unknown type. Which definitive regimen do you choose?

need.zh-CN: 先作出诊断（决策 2），调阅本阶段的药敏结果，并问过她的药物过敏史。
need.en: First make the diagnosis (decision 2), read this phase's susceptibility report and ask about her drug allergies.

text.zh-CN: 静脉万古霉素，从首次血培养转阴算起用 6 周，至少前 2 周联用庆大霉素，按血药浓度和肾功能调整剂量
text.en: IV vancomycin for 6 weeks from the first negative culture, with gentamicin for at least the first 2 weeks, doses guided by levels and renal function

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南对颗粒链菌和乏养菌（原称营养变异链球菌）推荐青霉素 G、头孢曲松或万古霉素治疗 6 周，至少前 2 周联用氨基糖苷类——这类细菌病程迁延，赘生物大，并发症和需要换瓣的比例高。她的青霉素过敏类型不明，万古霉素（30 mg/kg/d，分 2 次）避开了这个问题；庆大霉素 3 mg/kg/d、每日 1 次，需监测肾功能和血药浓度。疗程从首次血培养转阴之日算起。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2023 endocarditis recommends penicillin G, ceftriaxone or vancomycin for 6 weeks, with an aminoglycoside for at least the first 2 weeks, for Granulicatella and Abiotrophia (the former nutritionally variant streptococci), which run a prolonged course with large vegetations and high rates of complications and valve replacement. With a penicillin allergy of unknown type, vancomycin (30 mg/kg/day in 2 doses) avoids the question; gentamicin 3 mg/kg/day once daily needs renal and level monitoring. The course is counted from the first negative culture.

text.zh-CN: 静脉青霉素 G 联合庆大霉素 4 周：青霉素仍是口腔来源链球菌心内膜炎的首选药物
text.en: IV benzylpenicillin with gentamicin for 4 weeks, because penicillin is still the drug of choice for streptococcal endocarditis that starts in the mouth

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她自述青霉素过敏，反应类型还不清楚，在过敏评估之前使用青霉素可能引起严重过敏反应（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 药物过敏实践参数）。而且这类细菌需要 6 周疗程，4 周不够（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
feedback.en: No. She reports a penicillin allergy whose type is unknown, and giving a penicillin before it has been assessed risks a serious reaction (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy practice parameter). These organisms also need 6 weeks, not 4 (ESC 2023 endocarditis).

text.zh-CN: 静脉头孢曲松 2 g 每日 1 次联合庆大霉素，共 2 周，也就是口腔链球菌心内膜炎常用的短疗程方案
text.en: IV ceftriaxone 2 g once daily with gentamicin for 2 weeks, the short-course regimen used for streptococcal endocarditis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2 周短疗程只用于对青霉素高度敏感的口腔链球菌所致、无并发症、肾功能正常的自体瓣膜心内膜炎（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）；颗粒链菌感染合并重度反流、心衰和 25 mm 赘生物，需要 6 周。青霉素过敏者能否用头孢类，也要先弄清过敏反应的类型。
feedback.en: No. The 2-week course is only for uncomplicated native-valve endocarditis from highly penicillin-susceptible oral streptococci with normal renal function (ESC 2023 endocarditis); Granulicatella with severe regurgitation, heart failure and a 25-mm vegetation needs 6 weeks. Whether a cephalosporin is safe for her also depends on what her penicillin reaction was.

text.zh-CN: 单用静脉万古霉素 4 周，从第一剂算起，不加氨基糖苷类，以保护她的肾功能
text.en: IV vancomycin alone for 4 weeks counted from the first dose, with no aminoglycoside, so as to protect her kidneys

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。万古霉素选对了，但疗程和算法错了：这类细菌需要 6 周，至少前 2 周联用氨基糖苷类，并且从首次血培养转阴之日算起，而不是从第一剂算起（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。保护肾功能靠监测肾功能和血药浓度，而不是缩短疗程。
feedback.en: No. Vancomycin is the right drug, but the course is wrong: these organisms need 6 weeks with an aminoglycoside for at least the first 2, counted from the first negative culture, not from the first dose (ESC 2023 endocarditis). The kidneys are protected by monitoring renal function and drug levels, not by shortening the course.

text.zh-CN: 口服克林霉素 600 mg 每日 3 次，共 6 周，这样她可以回家完成治疗，不必一直住院
text.en: Oral clindamycin 600 mg three times daily for 6 weeks, so that she can finish treatment at home instead of in hospital

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。药敏报告这株细菌对克林霉素耐药；何况心内膜炎需要足疗程的静脉杀菌治疗，口服抑菌药不能替代（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。回家完成治疗只适用于病情稳定、没有手术指征的患者，她不符合。
feedback.en: No. The laboratory reported this organism resistant to clindamycin, and endocarditis needs a full course of IV bactericidal therapy that an oral bacteriostatic drug cannot replace (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Finishing treatment at home is for stable patients without a surgical indication, which she is not.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院时她不能平卧，颈静脉充盈，双肺底有湿啰音；经胸超声：主动脉瓣赘生物最大约 25 mm，伴瓣膜脱垂及重度反流，LVEF 48%，左心增大。诊断为确定的感染性心内膜炎。本病例没有记录她的生命体征。瓣膜怎么处理，什么时候处理？
prompt.en: On admission she could not lie flat, her neck veins were distended and there were crackles at both lung bases; the echo shows aortic-valve vegetations up to about 25 mm with prolapse and severe regurgitation, LVEF 48 % and an enlarged left heart. The diagnosis is definite endocarditis. No vital signs are recorded. What do you do about the valve, and when?

need.zh-CN: 先作出诊断（决策 2），并调阅本阶段的经胸超声心动图。
need.en: First make the diagnosis (decision 2) and read this phase's transthoracic echocardiogram.

text.zh-CN: 由心内膜炎团队安排 3–5 天内的限期手术；出现难治性肺水肿或休克时，改为 24 小时内急诊手术
text.en: Urgent surgery within 3–5 days, planned by the Endocarditis Team, brought forward to within 24 hours if pulmonary oedema becomes refractory or shock develops

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南：左心感染性心内膜炎导致重度反流并出现心衰症状（或超声提示血流动力学耐受差），推荐 3–5 天内的限期手术；难治性肺水肿或心源性休克则需 24 小时内急诊手术。≥ 10 mm 的赘生物还增加栓塞风险，进一步支持早期手术。决定由心内膜炎团队在有心外科的中心作出；抗菌药能控制感染，却修复不了受损的瓣膜。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2023 endocarditis: left-sided endocarditis with severe regurgitation causing symptoms of heart failure (or echo signs of poor haemodynamic tolerance) calls for urgent surgery within 3–5 days, and refractory pulmonary oedema or cardiogenic shock for emergency surgery within 24 hours. A vegetation of 10 mm or more adds embolic risk and strengthens the case for early surgery. The Endocarditis Team decides, in a centre with cardiac surgery; antibiotics control the infection but cannot repair the valve.

text.zh-CN: 先完成 6 周静脉抗菌疗程，等血培养持续阴性、心衰稳定、瓣膜不再有活动性感染以后，再择期行主动脉瓣置换术
text.en: Complete the 6-week IV antibiotic course first, then replace the aortic valve electively once the cultures stay negative, the infection is quiet and the heart failure has settled

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。心衰是感染性心内膜炎最常见的并发症，也是最常见的手术指征；等疗程结束再手术，会让她带着重度反流和大赘生物度过好几周（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。有手术指征时，不必等抗菌疗程结束。
feedback.en: No. Heart failure is the commonest complication of endocarditis and the commonest reason for surgery; waiting for the end of the course leaves her for weeks with severe regurgitation and a large vegetation (ESC 2023 endocarditis). When surgery is indicated, it does not wait for the antibiotic course to finish.

text.zh-CN: 先药物治疗：利尿、扩血管，靠抗菌药让赘生物缩小；只有出现心源性休克时才手术
text.en: Medical treatment for now — diuretics and vasodilators while antibiotics shrink the vegetation — with surgery only if cardiogenic shock develops

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。药物只能暂时缓解急性重度主动脉瓣反流造成的充血，瓣膜不会因此关紧；有心衰症状就应限期手术，而不是等到休克（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。到休克时再手术，风险要高得多。
feedback.en: No. Drugs only buy time against the congestion of acute severe aortic regurgitation; the valve will not close again. Symptoms of heart failure already call for urgent surgery, not shock (ESC 2023 endocarditis), and operating once she is in shock carries a far higher risk.

text.zh-CN: 等复查血培养转阴后再手术，以免在菌血症期间手术，让新换的瓣膜也感染上
text.en: Wait for negative repeat cultures before operating, so that surgery during bacteraemia does not infect the new valve

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。正在进行的感染不是手术禁忌：有指征时在抗菌治疗期间手术，术后继续完成疗程（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。等血培养转阴，只会让她带着重度反流继续心衰。
feedback.en: No. Active infection does not rule out surgery: when it is indicated she is operated on during antibiotic treatment and completes the course afterwards (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Waiting for sterile cultures leaves her in heart failure with severe regurgitation.

text.zh-CN: 今晚急诊手术：25 mm 的赘生物本身就要求 24 小时内手术，不必考虑她的心衰程度
text.en: Emergency surgery tonight: a 25-mm vegetation by itself sets a 24-hour deadline, whatever the degree of her heart failure

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。24 小时内的急诊手术针对难治性肺水肿或心源性休克；单凭赘生物大小，指南给出的是限期（数天内），而不是急诊时限（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。她的生命体征没有记录，无从判断是否休克：按限期手术准备，病情恶化时提前。
feedback.en: No. Emergency surgery within 24 hours is for refractory pulmonary oedema or cardiogenic shock; vegetation size alone sets an urgent timeline of days, not an emergency one (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Her vital signs are not recorded, so shock cannot be judged: plan urgent surgery and bring it forward if she deteriorates.

prompt.zh-CN: 接受以万古霉素为主的治疗后，复查血培养已转阴，她说比刚住院时好些了。现在要把她转到另一家医院；本病例没有记录转院的原因，也没有记录是否做过手术评估。她离开之前，最重要的是什么？
prompt.en: On vancomycin-based treatment her repeat blood cultures are negative, and she says she feels better than on admission. She is now to be transferred to another hospital; this case does not record why, or whether she had a surgical assessment. What matters most before she leaves?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 3 和 4，问她现在感觉怎样，并调阅本阶段复查的血培养。
need.en: First answer decisions 3 and 4, ask how she feels now and read this phase's repeat blood cultures.

text.zh-CN: 静脉治疗一剂不漏：交接病原、药敏、药物、剂量、血药浓度、首次转阴日期、停药日期和未定的手术决定
text.en: No missed IV dose: hand over the organism, susceptibilities, drugs, doses, levels, first negative culture date, stop date and the open surgical decision

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。疗程从首次血培养转阴之日算起，这类细菌需要 6 周（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）；转院是用药差错和治疗中断的高发环节，需要结构化交接并核对用药（WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全）。她的手术指征还没有解决，接收团队必须明确知道这一点。
feedback.en: Correct. The course is counted from the first negative culture and these organisms need 6 weeks (ESC 2023 endocarditis); a transfer is a high-risk point for medication errors and interrupted treatment, so it needs a structured handover and medicines reconciliation (WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care). Her surgical indication is still open, and the receiving team must know it.

text.zh-CN: 转院前就停用抗菌药：血培养已经转阴，她也好些了，说明感染已经控制住，疗程可以结束了
text.en: Stop the antibiotics before she leaves: the cultures are negative and she is better, so the infection is controlled and the course can end

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血培养转阴和症状好转只说明治疗起效，不代表治愈，更不代表瓣膜已经修复；疗程不足会让感染复燃，而重度反流依然存在（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
feedback.en: No. Negative cultures and improvement show that treatment is working, not that she is cured — still less that the valve has healed; a short course risks relapse, and the severe regurgitation remains (ESC 2023 endocarditis).

text.zh-CN: 转院途中和最初几天改为口服抗生素，到了新医院再由对方决定是否恢复静脉用药
text.en: Switch to an oral antibiotic for the journey and the first days there, and let the new hospital decide whether to restart IV treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南只对病情稳定、静脉治疗至少 10 天、没有需要手术的瓣膜病变的患者考虑部分口服治疗；她仍有重度反流和手术指征。转院途中换药，恰恰制造了要避免的治疗缺口。
feedback.en: No. ESC 2023 endocarditis considers partial oral treatment only for stable patients after at least 10 days of IV therapy with no valve lesion needing surgery; she still has severe regurgitation and a surgical indication. Changing drugs for the journey creates exactly the gap to avoid.

text.zh-CN: 写一份写明诊断和住院经过的出院小结就够了，抗菌药怎么选、用多久，都交给接收医院根据自己的评估决定
text.en: A discharge letter giving the diagnosis and the hospital course is enough; the receiving hospital can choose the antibiotics and their length after its own assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。只交一份诊断，接收医院不知道用了什么药、用了几天、血药浓度多少、什么时候该停，也不知道手术指征还没有解决；交接环节的信息缺失正是治疗中断的常见原因（WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全）。
feedback.en: No. A diagnosis alone leaves the receiving hospital without the drugs, the days completed, the levels, the stop date and the unresolved surgical indication — exactly the gaps through which treatment is interrupted at transitions of care (WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care).

text.zh-CN: 问清几个月来的经过：乏力纳差、近来气短到不能平卧、腰骶部疼痛、之前按脊柱关节炎和贫血治疗、起初没有发热
text.en: Established the months of fatigue and poor appetite, the recent breathlessness to the point of orthopnoea, the lumbosacral pain, the earlier treatment for spondyloarthritis and anaemia, and the lack of fever at the start

text.zh-CN: 在任何抗菌药之前询问看牙或其他操作、近期抗生素、药物过敏以及过敏反应的类型
text.en: Before any antibiotic, asked about dental work or other procedures, recent antibiotics, drug allergies and the type of allergic reaction

text.zh-CN: 查看面色和颈静脉，听诊心脏和双肺，并检查下肢水肿和皮肤出血点
text.en: Looked at her colour and neck veins, listened to her heart and lungs, and checked for leg oedema and petechiae

text.zh-CN: 调阅入院前的超声报告，结果回报后读取血培养、药敏和经胸超声心动图
text.en: Read the earlier echocardiogram report, then the blood cultures, susceptibilities and transthoracic echocardiogram once they came back

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即决定先采集血培养、再用抗菌药，并尽快完成超声心动图
text.en: Decided at the first attempt on cultures before any antibiotic and an urgent echocardiogram

text.zh-CN: 入院时先分别穿刺采集 3 套血培养，然后才开始万古霉素联合庆大霉素
text.en: On admission, drew three culture sets by separate venepunctures and only then started vancomycin with gentamicin

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即依据两项主要标准确定感染性心内膜炎，没有因为不发热而降级
text.en: Made a definite diagnosis of endocarditis on two major criteria at the first attempt, without downgrading it for the absence of fever

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择不含 β-内酰胺的 6 周方案，并核实了青霉素过敏史
text.en: Chose the 6-week regimen without a beta-lactam at the first attempt and clarified the penicillin allergy

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择限期手术，并在结果回报的阶段请心内膜炎团队会诊、转诊心外科
text.en: Chose urgent surgery at the first attempt and, while the results were in hand, involved the Endocarditis Team and referred her to cardiac surgery

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择治疗不中断的转院方案，在她离开前完成交接，也没有停用抗菌药
text.en: Chose an uninterrupted-treatment transfer at the first attempt, completed the handover before she left and did not stop the antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 没有使用青霉素或口服克林霉素，也没有把手术推迟到抗菌疗程结束之后
text.en: Gave no penicillin or oral clindamycin and did not postpone surgery until after the antibiotic course

text.zh-CN: 用 SPIKES 框架向她说明病情的严重性、限期手术的建议，以及为什么必须完成疗程
text.en: Used SPIKES to explain how serious her illness is, the advice for urgent surgery and why the course must be completed

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES，结合 Calgary–Cambridge 的解释与计划）：S——让她靠坐着，保护隐私，谈话简短、留出喘气的时间，问她是否希望家人在场；P——先问她自己怎么理解这几个月的病（她一直被当作脊柱关节炎和贫血治疗）；I——问她想知道多少细节；K——用通俗的话说明：心脏的一个瓣膜被细菌感染（很可能来自口腔），瓣膜关不严，所以喘、躺不平；要静脉输 6 周不含青霉素的抗菌药，同时因为瓣膜已经损坏，医生建议几天之内做手术，说明手术的必要性和风险；E——回应她“是不是心脏出了大毛病”的害怕，承认情况严重，不作虚假保证；S——说明接下来的检查和手术评估，用复述法确认她明白：即使觉得好了、血培养转阴，也绝不能停药，转院时输液也要接上；突然更喘、胸痛、肢体无力或说话不清要马上告诉医护人员。不编造病例中没有的结果，不承诺病例没有记录的结局。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES, with Calgary–Cambridge explanation and planning): Setting — she sits propped up, privacy, short sentences with time to breathe, asks whether she would like family present; Perception — first asks what she understands about these months (she has been treated for spinal arthritis and anaemia); Invitation — asks how much detail she wants; Knowledge — explains in plain words that a heart valve is infected by a germ (probably from the mouth) and no longer closes properly, which is why she is breathless and cannot lie flat; that she needs 6 weeks of drip antibiotics without penicillin; and that because the valve is already damaged, the doctors advise an operation within days, with its reasons and risks; Emotions — answers her fear that something is seriously wrong with her heart, acknowledges that it is serious, without false reassurance; Strategy and summary — explains the next tests and the surgical assessment and uses teach-back to check that she will never stop the treatment because she feels better or the cultures are clear, that the drip must continue through any transfer, and that sudden worse breathlessness, chest pain, weakness or trouble speaking must be reported at once. Invents no result the case does not record and promises no outcome it does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交班（ISBAR）：57岁女性，乏力、纳差数月，近来气短加重、不能平卧，刚收入病房，靠坐在床上。病房床旁有监护仪、氧气和输液泵，病房里有抢救车（留置针、常用药）和心电图机；超声仪要从超声室推来；护士站有病历终端。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作：建立静脉通路、按要求分别穿刺采集血培养（不经留置针抽取）、给药、吸氧。只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、体重、化验或长期用药时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Admission handover (ISBAR): a 57-year-old woman with months of tiredness and poor appetite, now increasingly breathless and unable to lie flat, just admitted to the ward and sitting propped up in bed. On the ward: a monitor, oxygen and an infusion pump at the bedside, the crash cart (cannulas, common drugs) and the ECG machine; the ultrasound machine is wheeled over from the ultrasound room; there is a records terminal at the nurses' station. Reads orders back and does nursing-scope tasks: IV access, blood cultures by separate venepunctures on request (never through the cannula), medicines, oxygen. Reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, weight, blood results or regular medicines, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 严医生（心内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“几个月的乏力、腰痛、贫血，加上现在的心衰，能不能用一个病解释？”“第一剂抗菌药之前，瓶子里必须有什么？”“没有发热会改变诊断吗？”“哪些发现算主要标准？”“她的过敏史排除了哪些药？怎么弄清当时是什么反应？”“抗菌药能让漏的瓣膜关紧吗？”“什么情况下手术要从限期变成急诊？”“疗程从哪一天算起？”“转院时最容易丢的是什么？”。可以讲解 ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南、2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准、ESC 2021 心衰指南、AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 药物过敏实践参数和 WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以把记录的处理与现行做法对照。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、体重、血常规、肾功能、心电图、胸片、经食管超声、脊柱和头颅影像、抗菌药的剂量和开始时间、过敏反应类型、是否做过手术评估、转院原因都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Can one illness explain months of tiredness, back pain and anaemia, and now heart failure?”, “What must be in the bottles before the first antibiotic dose?”, “Does the absence of fever change the diagnosis?”, “Which findings are major criteria?”, “Which drugs does her allergy rule out, and how would you find out what the reaction was?”, “Can antibiotics make a leaking valve close?”, “What would turn urgent surgery into an emergency?”, “From which day is the course counted?”, “What is most easily lost at a transfer?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2023 endocarditis, the 2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria, ESC 2021 heart failure, the AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy parameter and WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded care with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, weight, blood count, renal function, ECG, chest film, transoesophageal echo, spinal and brain imaging, antibiotic doses and start date, the type of allergic reaction, any surgical assessment and the reason for the transfer are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，只解读学员已经读过的血培养和药敏结果，并就用药提供建议：万古霉素 30 mg/kg/d、分 2 次，按血药浓度和肾功能调整；庆大霉素 3 mg/kg/d、每日 1 次，与万古霉素合用要监测肾毒性和血药浓度；本病例没有记录体重和肌酐，所以算不出具体剂量。药物过敏：先问清药物、反应表现、时间和处理；青霉素类的非严重、非速发型反应之后，头孢类通常可以耐受，严重速发型反应或严重皮肤反应之后，在过敏评估前避免所有 β-内酰胺类（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。转院：核对用药，交接已用天数（从首次血培养转阴算起）、最近的血药浓度和下一剂的时间。不报告学员尚未读到的结果。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist who interprets only the blood cultures and susceptibilities the learner has read and advises on the drugs: vancomycin 30 mg/kg/day in 2 doses, adjusted to levels and renal function; gentamicin 3 mg/kg/day once daily, watching nephrotoxicity and levels when combined with vancomycin; no weight or creatinine is recorded, so no dose can be calculated. Drug allergy: first establish the drug, the reaction, when it happened and how it was treated; after a non-severe, non-immediate reaction to a penicillin a cephalosporin is usually tolerated, while after a severe immediate reaction or a severe skin reaction all beta-lactams are avoided until an allergy assessment (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022). Transfer: reconcile the medicines and hand over the days completed (counted from the first negative culture), the latest levels and the time of the next dose. Never reports a result the learner has not read.

knowledge.zh-CN: 感染科医生，只解读学员已经读过的血培养和药敏：几套分别采集的血培养生长同一种细菌时，为什么是真正的菌血症而不是污染；报告中描述的培养特征（例如生长条件）意味着什么；2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准中的主要标准；没有 MIC 时怎样依据 ESC 2023 对该菌的推荐选药；疗程从首次血培养转阴算起；寻找感染来源（包括口腔）和口腔科评估。不编造采血时间、报阳时间、MIC 或复查血培养的细节（都没有记录）；不报告学员尚未读到的结果。
knowledge.en: Infectious diseases physician who interprets only the cultures and susceptibilities the learner has read: when growth of the same organism in several separately drawn sets is true bacteraemia rather than contamination; what the culture features the report describes (such as growth requirements) mean; the major criteria of the 2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria; how to choose treatment per ESC 2023 for the organism when no MIC is given; counting the course from the first negative culture; the search for a source (the mouth included) and a dental assessment. Never invents draw times, time to positivity, MICs or details of the repeat cultures (none is recorded), and never reports a result the learner has not read.

knowledge.zh-CN: 心外科医生，只解读学员已经读过的超声报告，并讲解 ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南的手术原则：感染导致重度瓣膜反流并出现心衰症状时为什么需要 3–5 天内的限期手术，什么情况下改为 24 小时内急诊手术，≥ 10 mm 的赘生物怎样增加栓塞风险；术前用经食管超声了解瓣周有无脓肿，头颅影像排除会影响手术时机的栓塞或出血，并处理口腔等感染灶。本病例没有记录经食管超声、头颅影像、手术评估或手术，绝不编造术中所见或手术结果；不报告学员尚未读到的结果。
knowledge.en: Cardiac surgeon who interprets only the echo reports the learner has read and explains the surgical principles of ESC 2023 endocarditis: why severe regurgitation from endocarditis with symptoms of heart failure calls for urgent surgery within 3–5 days, what makes it an emergency within 24 hours, and how a vegetation of 10 mm or more adds embolic risk; before surgery, a transoesophageal echo for perivalvular abscess, brain imaging for emboli or bleeding that would change the timing, and treatment of a source such as the teeth. This case records no transoesophageal echo, brain imaging, surgical assessment or operation: never invents operative findings or results, and never reports a result the learner has not read.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：不发热的亚急性心内膜炎、受损的主动脉瓣与转院时中断的治疗
title.en: Debrief: afebrile subacute endocarditis, a damaged aortic valve and treatment interrupted at transfer

conclusion.zh-CN: 57岁女性，乏力、纳差数月，后来腰骶部剧痛、腿活动不便，按脊柱关节炎和缺铁性贫血治疗无效；此前因牙髓炎看过牙，对青霉素过敏，起初没有发热；近来气短加重至不能平卧。查体皮肤黏膜苍白、颈静脉充盈、双肺底湿啰音，心尖部收缩期 3/6 级杂音和舒张期叹气样杂音；入院前超声已提示主动脉瓣可能有赘生物。抗菌药前 3 套血培养均为苛养颗粒链球菌（卫星现象；万古霉素敏感，红霉素、克林霉素耐药），超声见主动脉瓣赘生物最大约 25 mm、瓣膜脱垂伴重度反流、LVEF 48%：确定的主动脉瓣感染性心内膜炎合并心衰。以万古霉素为主的治疗后血培养转阴、短期好转；转院后抗菌治疗中断，随后突发进行性气短并死亡，机制未证实。按现行指南（ESC 2023）：抗菌药前采集血培养，万古霉素从首次转阴算起用 6 周、至少前 2 周联用庆大霉素，由心内膜炎团队安排限期手术，转院时治疗不断档。
conclusion.en: A 57-year-old woman had months of fatigue, poor appetite and severe lumbosacral pain, treated as spondyloarthritis and iron-deficiency anaemia without benefit, then breathlessness to the point of orthopnoea. She had had dental treatment for pulpitis, was allergic to penicillin and had no fever at first; she was pale, with distended neck veins, basal crackles and systolic and diastolic murmurs, and an earlier echo had raised a possible aortic vegetation. All three pre-antibiotic culture sets grew Granulicatella adiacens; echocardiography showed aortic vegetations up to about 25 mm, prolapse, severe regurgitation and LVEF 48 %: definite aortic-valve endocarditis with heart failure. On vancomycin-based treatment the cultures cleared and she improved briefly; after transfer the antibiotics were interrupted, and sudden progressive breathlessness and death followed. Today (ESC 2023): cultures before antibiotics, 6 weeks of vancomycin with gentamicin, urgent surgery and no gap at transfer.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 几个月的乏力、纳差、贫血和治不好的腰骶痛，加上舒张期杂音和心衰，又有看牙的经历——一个统一的诊断比三个互不相关的诊断更可能。
keyReasoning.en: Months of fatigue, poor appetite, anaemia and back pain that would not settle, then a diastolic murmur and heart failure after dental treatment: one unifying diagnosis is likelier than three unrelated ones.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 入院前超声提示的可疑赘生物，把怀疑变成了必须马上完成的检查：先抽血培养，再用抗菌药，同时做超声心动图。
keyReasoning.en: The earlier scan's possible vegetation turns suspicion into a work-up that cannot wait: cultures first, antibiotics after, and an echocardiogram alongside.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 3 套血培养生长同一种口腔来源的细菌、25 mm 的赘生物伴重度反流：两项主要标准，无论发不发热都已确定；卫星现象指向营养变异的颗粒链菌。
keyReasoning.en: The same oral organism in three sets and a 25-mm vegetation with severe regurgitation are two major criteria — definite with or without fever; satellitism points to a nutritionally variant Granulicatella.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 端坐呼吸、颈静脉充盈和湿啰音，加上重度主动脉瓣反流、LVEF 48% 和左心增大，说明心衰来自受损的瓣膜：手术是治疗的一部分，抗菌药关不上漏的瓣膜。
keyReasoning.en: Orthopnoea, distended neck veins and crackles, with severe aortic regurgitation, LVEF 48 % and an enlarged left heart, mean heart failure from a damaged valve: surgery is part of the treatment, because antibiotics cannot close a leaking valve.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血培养转阴和症状好转说明感染在控制之中，并不说明瓣膜已经修好或疗程已经完成；转院正是计划最容易断掉的时刻。
keyReasoning.en: Negative cultures and improvement show that the infection is being controlled, not that the valve is mended or the course complete; the transfer is exactly when the plan is most likely to break.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能证明手术或不间断的抗菌治疗本可以改变结局，也不能确定死亡机制。病例没有记录生命体征、体重、化验、心电图、胸片、经食管超声、脊柱和头颅影像、抗菌药剂量、手术评估和转院原因；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show that surgery or uninterrupted antibiotics would have changed the outcome, and it does not establish the mechanism of death. No vital signs, weight, blood tests, ECG, chest film, transoesophageal echo, spinal or brain imaging, antibiotic doses, surgical assessment or reason for the transfer are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征（包括“起初”之后的体温）和体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any point (including her temperature after the 'initial' afebrile period) and her weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 化验与床旁检查：血红蛋白和铁代谢、白细胞、C 反应蛋白和血沉、肾功能、利钠肽、心电图和胸片。
unknowns.en: Laboratory and bedside tests: haemoglobin and iron studies, white cells, CRP and ESR, renal function, natriuretic peptide, ECG and chest film.

unknowns.zh-CN: 青霉素过敏的具体反应和时间；长期用药，以及血培养之前是否用过抗生素。
unknowns.en: What her penicillin reaction was and when; her regular medicines, and whether she had any antibiotic before the cultures.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整的抗菌方案（联用药物、剂量、开始日期、血药浓度）、各药的 MIC、复查血培养的套数和首次转阴的日期。
unknowns.en: The full antibiotic regimen (companion drugs, doses, start date, levels), the MICs, the number of repeat culture sets and the date of the first negative culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否做过经食管超声、脊柱或头颅影像；有无瓣周脓肿；二尖瓣的情况。
unknowns.en: Whether a transoesophageal echo or spinal or brain imaging was done; any perivalvular abscess; the state of the mitral valve.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否请心内膜炎团队或心外科评估，是否建议或实施过瓣膜手术。
unknowns.en: Whether the Endocarditis Team or a cardiac surgeon assessed her, and whether valve surgery was offered or performed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 转院的原因和时间、抗菌治疗中断了多久，以及从转院到死亡隔了多久。
unknowns.en: Why and when she was transferred, how long the antibiotics were interrupted, and the time from transfer to death.

unknowns.zh-CN: 死亡机制：报告考虑瓣膜破坏、栓塞或急性左心衰竭，均未证实；是否做过尸检。
unknowns.en: The mechanism of death: the report considers valve destruction, embolism or acute left heart failure, none confirmed; whether an autopsy was done.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不发热也要想到心内膜炎。亚急性感染性心内膜炎常以乏力、纳差、贫血、骨骼肌肉痛和心衰起病，发热只是次要标准（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准）。在任何抗菌药之前分别穿刺采集至少 3 套血培养，再做经胸超声，不明确或怀疑瓣周并发症时加做经食管超声（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。记录与现行做法：她入院前的超声已经提示可疑赘生物，本病例没有记录当时据此做了什么；她抗菌药前的 3 套血培养全部阳性。
teachingPoints.en: Think of endocarditis without fever. Subacute infective endocarditis often presents with fatigue, poor appetite, anaemia, musculoskeletal pain and heart failure, and fever is only a minor criterion (2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria). Take at least three culture sets by separate venepunctures before any antibiotic, then a transthoracic echo, adding a transoesophageal study when it is inconclusive or a perivalvular complication is suspected (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Then and now: her earlier scan had already raised a possible vegetation, and this case does not record what followed; all three of her pre-antibiotic culture sets were positive.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 两项主要标准即可确诊。同一种细菌在 3 套独立血培养中生长（2023 年 Duke-ISCVID 标准把颗粒链菌和乏养菌列为典型致病菌），加上超声所见赘生物，就是确定的感染性心内膜炎；卫星现象提示营养变异链球菌，不是污染或混合生长。
teachingPoints.en: Two major criteria are enough. The same organism in three separate culture sets (the 2023 Duke-ISCVID criteria list Granulicatella and Abiotrophia among the typical organisms) and a vegetation on echo make endocarditis definite; satellitism marks a nutritionally variant streptococcus, not contamination or mixed growth.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 颗粒链菌要按更难治的细菌对待。ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南推荐青霉素 G、头孢曲松或万古霉素治疗 6 周，至少前 2 周联用氨基糖苷类；青霉素过敏类型不明时，用万古霉素 30 mg/kg/d、分 2 次（按血药浓度和肾功能调整），庆大霉素 3 mg/kg/d、每日 1 次，同时问清过敏反应（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。疗程从首次血培养转阴算起。记录与现行做法：她接受的是以万古霉素为主的治疗；对红霉素、克林霉素耐药，也排除了这两种口服药。
teachingPoints.en: Treat Granulicatella as a harder organism. ESC 2023 endocarditis recommends penicillin G, ceftriaxone or vancomycin for 6 weeks with an aminoglycoside for at least the first 2; with a penicillin allergy of unknown type, vancomycin 30 mg/kg/day in 2 doses (adjusted to levels and renal function) and gentamicin 3 mg/kg/day once daily, while the reaction is clarified (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022). The course is counted from the first negative culture. Then and now: she received vancomycin-based treatment; resistance to erythromycin and clindamycin rules out those two oral options.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 瓣膜受损要手术，不能等疗程结束。ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南：重度反流合并心衰症状是 3–5 天内限期手术的指征，难治性肺水肿或心源性休克需 24 小时内急诊手术；≥ 10 mm 的赘生物增加栓塞风险。由心内膜炎团队在有心外科的中心决定。记录与现行做法：本病例没有记录任何手术评估；抗菌治疗后的好转只是短暂的。
teachingPoints.en: A damaged valve needs surgery, not the end of the course. ESC 2023 endocarditis: severe regurgitation with symptoms of heart failure is an indication for urgent surgery within 3–5 days, and refractory pulmonary oedema or cardiogenic shock for emergency surgery within 24 hours; a vegetation of 10 mm or more adds embolic risk. The Endocarditis Team decides, in a centre with cardiac surgery. Then and now: this case records no surgical assessment, and the improvement on antibiotics was short-lived.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 转院不能让治疗断档。血培养转阴和症状好转不等于治愈或瓣膜修复（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）；转院前要核对用药并结构化交接——病原、药敏、药物、剂量、血药浓度、首次转阴日期、预定停药日期和尚未解决的手术决定（WHO 2019 交接环节用药安全）。记录与现行做法：她转院后抗菌治疗中断，随后突发进行性气短并死亡，机制未证实。
teachingPoints.en: A transfer must not break the treatment. Negative cultures and improvement are not cure or a mended valve (ESC 2023 endocarditis); before a transfer, reconcile the medicines and hand over in a structured way — organism, susceptibilities, drugs, doses, levels, the date of the first negative culture, the planned stop date and the unresolved surgical decision (WHO 2019 medication safety in transitions of care). Then and now: after her transfer the antibiotics were interrupted, and sudden progressive breathlessness and death followed, mechanism unconfirmed.

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征（包括“起初”之后的体温）和体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any point (including her temperature after the 'initial' afebrile period) and her weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 化验与床旁检查：血红蛋白和铁代谢、白细胞、C 反应蛋白和血沉、肾功能、利钠肽、心电图和胸片。
unknowns.en: Laboratory and bedside tests: haemoglobin and iron studies, white cells, CRP and ESR, renal function, natriuretic peptide, ECG and chest film.

unknowns.zh-CN: 青霉素过敏的具体反应和时间；长期用药，以及血培养之前是否用过抗生素。
unknowns.en: What her penicillin reaction was and when; her regular medicines, and whether she had any antibiotic before the cultures.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整的抗菌方案（联用药物、剂量、开始日期、血药浓度）、各药的 MIC、复查血培养的套数和首次转阴的日期。
unknowns.en: The full antibiotic regimen (companion drugs, doses, start date, levels), the MICs, the number of repeat culture sets and the date of the first negative culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否做过经食管超声、脊柱或头颅影像；有无瓣周脓肿；二尖瓣的情况。
unknowns.en: Whether a transoesophageal echo or spinal or brain imaging was done; any perivalvular abscess; the state of the mitral valve.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否请心内膜炎团队或心外科评估，是否建议或实施过瓣膜手术。
unknowns.en: Whether the Endocarditis Team or a cardiac surgeon assessed her, and whether valve surgery was offered or performed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 转院的原因和时间、抗菌治疗中断了多久，以及从转院到死亡隔了多久。
unknowns.en: Why and when she was transferred, how long the antibiotics were interrupted, and the time from transfer to death.

unknowns.zh-CN: 死亡机制：报告考虑瓣膜破坏、栓塞或急性左心衰竭，均未证实；是否做过尸检。
unknowns.en: The mechanism of death: the report considers valve destruction, embolism or acute left heart failure, none confirmed; whether an autopsy was done.
